How Atelier Index Works Under the Hood

No neural network is trained per closet. Instead, in-browser briaai/RMBG-1.4 removes photo backgrounds and frozen Marqo-FashionCLIP encodes each garment into a 512-D vector (closet-mean centered & nudged by your fabric and attribute tags), while two closed-form Dual Ridge Regression models compute separate Style (pure aesthetic + formality), Weather / Indoor, and Comfort scores alongside Certainty.

Model 1 · Style & Pairing

Weighted Dual Ridge + 512-D Pairwise Interactions

Simply averaging item vectors fails when A+B = good and C+D = good, yet A+D = bad. Multiplying each pair element-by-element (v_A ⊙ v_B) creates a distinct 512-D interaction vector for every combination.

  • Weather-Independent Style Score: Blends Aesthetic Dual Ridge + OOD Taste + Pairwise 512-D (`78%`) with Comfort & Formality (`22%`)—so changing temperature or rain never alters an outfit's Style score.
  • Centered FashionCLIP & Formality Conditioning: Single-item 512-D vectors are centered against your closet mean before outfit/pair kernels, removing narrow-cone bias. Formality (1–5) uses smooth distance decay (`1.0×` exact match, `−0.14` per step, floor `0.55×`), and Comfort is tracked separately from Style.
  • Culprit Isolation & Aesthetic Recency (`W`): Tagging clashing pieces isolates negative pair rows, while optional exponential decay (`Off / 90d / 60d / 30d`) lets your style evolve over time.
Model 2 · Thermal Comfort

ASHRAE 55 clo Physics + Dual Ridge Residual

Instead of arbitrary warmth heuristics, each garment gets a published ASHRAE 55 clo insulation estimate projected from CLIP (and blended with manual Warmth), stacked via empirical physics, then personalized by Dual Ridge over your thermal logs.

  • Outdoor vs. Indoor A/C: Outdoor mode uses live Open-Meteo feels-like forecasts + rain/wind checks; Indoor mode skips rain/wind, uses A/C presets (`60–75°F`), and penalizes heavy outerwear (`warmth ≥ 4`).
  • 15 `clo` Prompts (Incl. Full Body & Accessories): Dresses/jumpsuits project to `0.28–0.48 clo`; scarves/beanies ~`0.10 clo`; belts/bags `0.00 clo`. Thermal Dual Ridge stays undecayed since physiology doesn't drift seasonally.
  • Try-On Safe: Logging `"Unknown (Try-on)"` skips the thermal matrix so quick mirror try-ons never skew your weather curve.
Model 3 · Inspo Match & 512-D Orthogonal Gaps

Category-Aware Inspo Search & 512-D Gap Synthesis

In Inspo Match, dragging a box isolates each garment into its own 512-D vector (nudged by text + slot attributes) and performs category-aware 1-to-1 matching without replacement. In Gap Analysis, candidates are scanned pairwise across 100% of your season-overlapping closet, and 25 Orthogonal Gaps are optimized in 512-D using the full Dual Ridge kernel gradient μ(v) + β·σ(v) over all outfit logs (Safe = high certainty, Balanced = pure predicted style, Explore = low-certainty blind spots)—then projected to stay aligned with your 1–4D taste subspace while staying 100% perpendicular to non-taste owned closet dimensions and each other.

Model 4 · Certainty, Retire Audit & Adaptive Sizing

Separate Certainty, Redundancy Audits & Log-Driven Sizing

Missing data is never faked with zeros: optional attributes and fit signals (`Labeled Size` + `Fit Outcome`, plus the 2-D masked ease/bulk sub-vector) stay unbiased while proportionally lowering Certainty.

  • Multiplicative Retire Risk & Live Threshold: Combines smooth usage (`staple` < `regular` < `rare` < `never`), seasonality damping (`×0.45` off-season), cluster redundancy (`≥92%` CLIP + close color, scaling from 1 to 4+ twins with `#1` keeper protection), and pain/orphan signals against an adjustable Retire Threshold slider (default `50%`).
  • Baseline-Checked Brand Learning & Unified Try-Ons: Learns brand cut biases from both Owned pieces and saved In-Store Try-Ons (with RMBG-1.4 cutouts, editable anytime under Closet → In-Store Try-Ons), checking against your all-brand baseline and anchoring directly without double-shifting when you already have same-brand Ideal Fits.
  • Log-Driven 512-D Sizing: Supports photo upload (with RMBG-1.4), text nudges, and full garment attributes to weight your baseline size by 512-D similarity and learn Size Down / Baseline / Size Up preferences from past similar pairings, plus hard layering/sock clearance guardrails.
